performance.measurement: /usr/bin/time -v around pixi run -e test python examples/verify_periodic.py --macro 8 --native-threads 1 --reference-levels 32 plus the specified local resolution/segments
performance.scope: end-to-end serial acquisition includes Pixi startup, a tiny conforming Q1/32 pilot,64 local condensation/reconstruction cells, all global trace solves, transfers/persistence and exact pressure/broken-H1 comparisons; host activity and lightweight concurrent validation were not controlled
performance.interpretation: bounded-memory observations for two local resolutions; no controlled speedup claim and no claim of classical reference convergence
